text: After departure, a rushed handover at the desk touched treat supplies and created confusion around a pet travel file. Incident report on missed connection at the Companion Animal Travel Desk. I was the shift coordinator on duty when the incoming desk staff member left a partial briefing and the next passenger line formed before the review was complete. One traveler arrived with Chester and asked for support after being told the flight plan had shifted. The records showed that the pet documents had been checked, but the handover notes were incomplete and the companion feeding instructions were not clearly passed along. The traveler remained calm, though visibly concerned, and the delay at the counter caused the family to miss the intended boarding sequence for Aurelia Skyways. <<FACT F110>> I paused the line, confirmed the animal welfare details, and checked the reservation notes with the operations desk. After that, I arranged a new service path, explained the next available steps in plain language, and made sure the traveler had water, a quiet seating area, and support for the pet carrier. I also asked a second team member to recheck the supply cabinet and the handover log so that nothing else would be missed. The handling was respectful throughout, and no injury or distress to the animal was observed. The immediate follow-up included a written note to the duty supervisor, a reminder to keep handover notes complete, and a review of desk coverage so that the next shift would not face the same gap. I also spoke with the traveler before departure from the desk area to confirm understanding and reduce stress. The Companion Animal Travel Desk will reinforce brief exchange standards and keep a closer check on transition tasks. The matter was contained, and service resumed in an orderly manner.
